Dialogflow CX CLI

The missing CLI for your Dialogflow CX projects.

--- `cxcli` is a command-line tool that helps Dialogflow CX users test their agents and interact with them in various ways. It is useful for your day-to-day tasks or if you want to integrate it with your favorite CI tool. This CLI also allows you to interact with the [text-to-speech](/tts) and [speech-to text](/stt) APIs in Google Cloud. --- ## Get cxcli - [On your machine](https://cxcli.xavidop.me/overview/install/); ## Documentation Documentation is hosted live at https://cxcli.xavidop.me/ ## Community You have questions, need support and or just want to talk about cxcli?
